svg.title: Minecraft Halloween tech stack
svg.desc: Five bold category signs and twenty fixed pixel-art technology items. LANGUAGES: Python, C++, HTML, CSS. FRAMEWORKS: PyTorch, FastAPI, Streamlit, scikit-learn, LangChain, LangGraph. DATABASES: PostgreSQL, ChromaDB. TOOLS: Git, GitHub, Docker, VS Code, Jupyter. AI CODING AGENTS: Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity. The spider crawls on the shelf, lowers on anchored silk and climbs back with moving legs. Corner webs stay attached to beams and posts. Clouds, bats, leaves, ghost and pumpkin light move; technology labels stay fixed.
